data.text: The cinema did not emerge as a form of mass consumption until its technology evolved from the initial "peepshow" format to the point where images were projected on a screen in a darkened theater.
data.translation: 直到电影技术从最初的“窥视秀”格式发展到在昏暗剧院的屏幕上投影图像的程度时，电影才作为一种大众消费形式出现。
